description: This file defines the TranslateController class for managing translation-related actions within the Goteo project, including listing, editing, and managing translation models and system texts.

classes.name: TranslateController
classes.description: Controller class for managing translation interfaces, including listing, editing, and adding translation models, with support for different zones and system texts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets theme, loads languages based on user role, and sets context variables.

methods.name: addTranslateModel
methods.description: Adds a new translation model/table to a specified zone.

methods.name: createSidebar
methods.description: Creates sidebar menu entries for navigation within translation zones.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Displays the main translation index page with recent translation feeds.

methods.name: doList
methods.description: Handles listing of translation entries with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: doEdit
methods.description: Handles editing and saving translation entries, including deletion and logging.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists translation entries for a specific zone.

methods.name: editTextAction
methods.description: Edits a specific system text translation.
